title: The Global Entrepreneurship and Development Index
abstract: Chapter in Acs, Szerb & Autio's 'Global Entrepreneurship and Development Index 2014' (SpringerBriefs in Economics 2015). Presents the GEDI framework and updated country rankings. No standalone chapter abstract for SpringerBriefs volumes.
summary_en: Ács, Szerb and Autio's 2014 GEDI volume (SpringerBriefs) updates the framework and country rankings to mid-decade data. The book systematically presents the index methodology, sub-component construction, and country profiles for ~75 countries, including how each country compares on entrepreneurial attitudes, abilities, and aspirations. The bottleneck approach is refined further. Country profiles serve as a benchmarking tool for national policy bodies considering entrepreneurship reforms.
data_used: Global Entrepreneurship Monitor (GEM) survey data combined with 2014 institutional indicators across ~75 countries, with country-by-country profiles showing strengths and weaknesses.
policy_relevance: The 2014 volume includes a Hungarian country profile useful for ITM, KKM, HIPA, and other entrepreneurship-policy bodies. Provides specific bottleneck identification for Hungary that informs targeted policy interventions rather than broad-based programmes.
